description.value:
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp (lesser), 20,000 gp (normal), 40,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 2 sp

Anyone targeted by your spells or sphere effects, attempting a save against them, or within their area becomes frightened for 1d4+1 rounds unless they succeed at a Will saving throw using the same DC as the original spell. On a successful save they instead become shaken for 1d4+1 rounds. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. Characters must only save against this effect once per spell or sphere effect it is applied to even if the modified spell requires additional saves.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Horrifying Imagination; Cost 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Use as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect while holding this apparatus in at least one hand. The effect must be caster level seven or lower. Spend one of 3 daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat’s extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Targets, creatures attempting a save and creatures in the area make one Will save per modified effect, even if it calls for repeated saves. Failure causes frightened for 1d4+1 rounds; success instead causes shaken for that duration. This is mind-affecting fear.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
